What is Our Video Downloader?

Our Video Downloader is a powerful bookmarklet that extracts videos from any webpage. It automatically detects video elements, embedded players, and streaming content. Simply click the bookmark to scan the page and download videos.

Whether you're saving tutorial videos, product demos, or educational content, our tool makes it easy to download videos directly to your device.

Features — Video Downloader

  • Smart Video Detection: Automatically finds all videos including HTML5 video tags, embedded players, and streaming content.
  • Streaming Video Detection: Identifies YouTube, Vimeo, and other streaming platforms (note: direct download may not be available for streaming videos).
  • HLS Support: Detects and supports HLS (m3u8) streaming videos.
  • Gallery Preview: Visual video preview with duration, resolution, and file type information.
  • Batch Download: Download selected videos or all videos at once as a convenient ZIP file.
  • Privacy-Focused: All processing happens locally in your browser. Your data stays private.

How to Use the Video Downloader

  1. Install: Drag the purple 'Video Downloader' button to your bookmarks bar.
  2. Navigate: Go to any webpage containing videos you want to download.
  3. Scan: Click the bookmark to scan the page for videos.
  4. Select: Choose which videos to download using filters or manual selection.
  5. Download: Click download to save as a ZIP file or download individual videos.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I use this to download videos?

Install the bookmarklet by dragging it to your bookmarks bar. Then, when you're on any page with videos you want, just click the bookmark. The tool will show you all the videos it found, and you can download them.

Can I download YouTube or Vimeo videos?

The tool detects streaming videos from platforms like YouTube and Vimeo and displays them in the list. However, due to platform restrictions, direct download may not be available for these streaming videos.

What video formats are supported?

The tool supports MP4, WebM, OGG, and HLS (m3u8) formats. The gallery view shows you the format and details of each video.

Can I download multiple videos at once?

Yes! Select multiple videos using the checkboxes or click 'Select All', then download them as a single ZIP file.

Does this work on private or password-protected sites?

If you can see the videos in your browser (because you're logged in), the tool can extract them. It uses whatever access you already have in your browser.

Is this really free?

Yes, completely free. No limits, no sign-ups, no hidden costs. Use it as much as you want.
